en: Sepia-toned image showing a historic town hall building with a steep gabled roof and multiple small windows. The foreground displays a square with a few people standing near the entrance. The facade includes arched doorways, decorative stonework, and coats of arms. To the right, a staircase rises along the side of the building, and adjacent structures and a church-like building are visible. Printed text at the top left reads "EISLEBEN Rathaus" and a red handwritten number appears in the top right corner.
